messages:
alex: Heads-up — nightly CI SAST is failing on main after an RBAC change. Error is a KMS decrypt permission denied for the scan artifact. Anyone on infra? cc @eng-infra
ci-bot: Pipeline failed: job=ci/sast-scan id=221. See logs below.

```
ERROR: failed to fetch artifact: kms.Decrypt failed: access denied for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/scans/cryptoKeys/redwood-prod-scan-key
stack: scanner.go:142
Cause: iam policy denies `cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for serviceAccount:scan-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

sam: :eyes: on it, linking PRs — which PR rotated RBAC?
alex: PR #4521 — infra team rotated keystore service account and removed the legacy role `roles/kms.cryptoOperator` to tighten privileges (per least-priv). I called it out in the PR but didn't fully validate CI integrations.
maria: Removing that role is fine if the new binding includes `cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` scoped to the key. Did the PR add the new key-binding?
jordan: Looking at audit logs: no KMS.Decrypt attempts logged from scan-runner after 2026-03-21T16:58Z. There is a `setIamPolicy` from infra-automation@redwood-bots at 2026-03-21T16:58:12Z that changed bindings on the key.
sam: Can you paste the exact error when you try to decrypt locally?
alex: Tried repro locally with same SA (impersonated):

```
$ gcloud kms decrypt \
  --location=global --keyring=scans --key=redwood-prod-scan-key \
  --ciphertext-file=scan-art.enc --plaintext-file=- \
  --impersonate-service-account=scan-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
ERROR: (gcloud.kms.decrypt) PERMISSION_DENIED: Resource 'projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/scans/cryptoKeys/redwood-prod-scan-key' not found or permission denied.
```

oncall: Short-term mitigation: re-add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `scan-runner@...` for that key (or re-grant via key-specific binding). Then re-run CI. We should treat this as P1 until scans green. :fire_engine: @maria @sam
maria: I opened a rollback PR to restore the key binding while we sort the new least-priv mapping — https://git.internal/infra/PR/4567 (WIP).
sec-bot: Playbook link: https://wiki.internal/redwood/sec/sdlc/kms-rotation-playbook — follow Immediate Grant -> Audit Proof -> Hardening steps. Also tag: #security-incidents if we see suspicious setIamPolicy events.
jordan: Two notes: 1) the `setIamPolicy` actor is infra-automation which is expected, but timing is odd (no overlapping deployment was scheduled). 2) There's a potential audit log gap: I don't see Decrypt attempts before 16:58 and none after — makes it likely permission removal happened mid-run. Escalating to sec-incidents to review if automation misapplied change.
sam: I'll merge the rollback binding now and then kick the pipeline.
ci-bot: Triggered rebuild: ci/sast-scan id=222 (triggered by sam).
ci-bot: Status: failed -> caused by earlier artifact not present. Retrying artifact fetch after rebind...
ci-bot: Status: succeeded (sast-scan id=222).
alex: Thanks team — scans are green again.
maria: Follow-ups: 1) add a preflight check in infra repo that runs an impersonated `gcloud kms decrypt --dryrun` against critical keys before merging RBAC changes; 2) add a dedicated test in CI that validates `scan-runner` still has `cryptoKeyDecrypter` after infra changes.
jordan: Also file an alert: if Decrypt PERMISSION_DENIED from scan-runner > 5 in 5m, page oncall + eng-infra.
sam: I'll create the JIRA: SECURITY-778 "SAST pipeline KMS preflight + alerting" and pick up the preflight.
oncall: Update the incident log and attach the setIamPolicy diff + timeline. We should also consider adding an automated roll-forward policy for infra automation to prevent accidental removal of key bindings that break svc integrations.
sec-bot: Added checklist item for postmortem: verify infra-automation credentials & rotation logs, and mark whether the setIamPolicy matches an approved change window.
alex: I'll add notes to weekly security sync. Closing thread once JIRA is created and rollback confirmed.
